data.text:
The Philippines has been struck by “very intense” Typhoon Fung‑wong (locally “Uwan”), which made landfall on Luzon in the province of Aurora late Sunday, bringing sustained winds of around 185 km/h and gusts up to 230 km/h. 

Over 900,000 people were evacuated and at least two people died. Authorities issued warnings of destructive winds, storm surges and heavy rain, up to 200 mm in some areas, that risk life-threatening flooding and landslides. 

The storm joins Typhoon Kalmaegi, which had hit just days earlier.

Read more: https://t.co/BOFwmTfyki
